question.text: Ms. Kavita Rao is building a slide on 'Channels for making investments' per Section 2.4. Which of the following is NOT listed in the chapter as a managed-portfolio channel for investors in India?

answer.text: Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) offering personal loans

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 2.4.2 enumerates the managed-portfolio channels: Mutual Funds, Collective Investment Schemes, Portfolio Management Services, Alternative Investment Funds, and Specialized Investment Funds (SIFs, added via SEBI MF Third Amendment 2024). NBFCs offering personal loans are not listed — they are lenders, not investment-management pools for investors' savings. The Trap: Options A, B and C are all explicitly listed. The NBFC distractor tempts those confusing financial intermediaries broadly with investment channels. SIF would also have been a correct 'is listed' answer — note its recency (Dec 16, 2024). Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B (Portfolio Manager) deep-dives PMS. XIX-A/B (AIF Distributors) deep-dive AIFs. XIX-E frames the same taxonomy as channel choices for accessing alternatives. Manager's Pro-Tip: When Cat III is the right structural answer, your slide deck should articulate WHY AIF over PMS or SIF — AIF gives you fund-level leverage (2x), performance-fee HWM crystallisation, and pooled-vehicle derivatives access that PMS cannot provide; SIF (MF-based) cannot offer the same strategy breadth.
